arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import math

# End of CY 1945 to end of CY 1955 = 10 years
start = 429.5  # millions, end of CY 1945
end = 807.0    # millions, end of CY 1955
years = 1955 - 1945  # = 10

# Continuously compounded average annual growth rate
ccagr = math.log(end / start) / years
print(f'Start: {start}')
print(f'End: {end}')
print(f'Years: {years}')
print(f'Ratio: {end/start}')
print(f'ln(ratio): {math.log(end/start)}')
print(f'CCAGR: {ccagr}')
print(f'CCAGR (4 decimals): {ccagr:.4f}')
print(f'CCAGR (3 decimals): {ccagr:.3f}')
"
